method: Independent full physical-word expansion, physical spin-ladder operations and direct first-leg contractions; no canonical ladder or contraction code imported. Exact integer equations and modular full-rank certificates prove the positive functional vanishes on the complete constraint kernel.
realSymmetricRestriction: Without loss: average the SU(2)-invariant moment with its entrywise conjugate. The Young support, all rank1/rank2 constraints, trace and positivity are preserved. The real highest-weight basis turns this into entrywise conjugation of every invariant block.
positiveSemidefiniteArgument: Every invariant coefficient block is positive semidefinite even though its multiplicity basis is not orthogonal: the full intertwiner is injective, so positivity is equivalent under congruence. All57 diagonal coordinates are nonnegative. Their strictly positive weighted sum vanishes, forcing every diagonal and hence every block to vanish. This contradicts trace1 of the twirled normalized wedge-square moment.
